trivia.title: Banana trivia
trivia.gone: This question has come down off the board.

questions.q: The statue in the middle of Banana Town has no plaque. Who is it?
questions.fact: Nobody in town knows. Gran Fig has measured its base with a tape measure, though.

questions.q: What is on the roof of the Coffee Cup?
questions.fact: A propeller. Bean, who keeps the kiosk, wears a propeller beanie to match.

questions.q: What is the only sign of the Mayor in Banana Town?
a: A light in the town hall’s upper window
A voice from the bell tower
questions.fact: Nobody has met the Mayor. There is only the light in that window.

questions.q: Who writes every name in the big book at the town hall?
questions.fact: Nib, the town hall clerk, in a top hat and round glasses.

questions.q: What does Moss do in Banana Town?
questions.fact: Moss is the street sweeper who keeps the cobbles clear.

questions.q: What does Pip carry around the General Store?
questions.fact: Pip runs the General Store, where each one is the last one.

questions.q: What is the name of Bean’s coffee kiosk?
questions.fact: Bean turns each finished cup and reads your future in it.

questions.q: Who is Fig Jr.’s grandmother?
questions.fact: Fig Jr. runs the lemonade stand with Gran Fig’s lemons.

questions.q: What does Gran Fig wear on her head?
questions.fact: Gran Fig grows the orchard and the west garden, snail and all.

questions.q: Who runs the Arcade in Banana Town?
questions.fact: Spinner, in a hat with three bells. Lose at Banana Pong and the screen says SPINNER WINS.

questions.q: What is always first on Dot’s list of lost things?
questions.fact: Dot keeps the list at the map counter, and the fish has never been found.

questions.q: What does Twirl hold while keeping the Wheel of Peel?
questions.fact: Twirl taps the rim of the wheel twice before every spin.

questions.q: How many toes has Tally counted on the statue?
questions.fact: Tally keeps the Exchange, where the residents’ orders are pinned up. And counts things.

questions.q: Which of these is a wedge on the Wheel of Peel?
questions.fact: The wedges include a firework, a peel, a lure, spin again, coins and THE POT.

questions.q: What is Banana Town at its very best on the town health meter?
questions.fact: It goes Abandoned, Struggling, Recovering, Lively and Thriving.

questions.q: On a cursed night, how do you chase a ghost off the square?
questions.fact: Ghosts undo the day’s fixes, so walking into them is a public service.

questions.q: What time does the Lost-Hour Clock show?
questions.fact: It is one of the cursed things that turn up at night. The Night Trading stall will buy it.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT an Arcade cabinet in Banana Town?
questions.fact: The five cabinets are Peel Out, Banana Snake, Banana Invaders, Banana Pong and Banana Stack.

questions.q: Who runs the bar at the Rave?
questions.fact: Barty the bartender, who never sleeps.

questions.q: Who is the DJ at the Rave?
questions.fact: The banana of the day moonlights as the DJ.

questions.q: What is the first title a banana gets at the Rave?
questions.fact: The titles climb all the way from Fresh Peel to Practically Staff.

questions.q: What do you flip when the power cuts at the Rave?
questions.fact: When the power cuts the LED wall goes to static, and the breaker box brings the lights back.

questions.q: Who is the park’s oldest banana?
questions.fact: Old Peel kept the park for forty years. His flowerbed has a daisy, a sunflower and one midnight tulip.

questions.q: Which bird is the rare visitor to the park?
questions.fact: Twelve kinds of bird visit the park, and the hummingbird is the very rare one.

questions.q: When do the butterflies come to the park?
questions.fact: Squirrels come back when the park is nearly healthy, and butterflies only when it is perfect.

questions.q: Where do bananas spend coins on things to wear?
questions.fact: The Banana Stand, including pieces drawn by players in the Pixel Forge, each with its maker’s name.

questions.q: Who runs the treasure dig at Banana Bay?
questions.fact: Captain Sabreface wears a tricorn and an eye patch, and once lost a good hat down a hole.

questions.q: Which fish are the legendary ones in Gil’s fish book?
a: The Great White Shark and the Anglerfish
questions.fact: Gil keeps a fish book of the bay, and two of the fish in it are legendary.

questions.q: What does Shelly keep a peg free for?
questions.fact: Shelly keeps the shell collection, and the junonia is one of the legendary shells.

questions.q: What waits in the Grabber at the end of the pier?
questions.fact: The giant plush banana. No luck involved, says the machine.

questions.q: Which of these is a stall at Banana Bay?
questions.fact: The midway has Hook-a-Duck, Whack-a-Crab, the Coconut Hut and the Prize Counter.

questions.q: On a homestead, what comes after the tent?
questions.fact: Pitch a tent, get a real roof (a mobile home or a barn), then build the house.

questions.q: Which animal gives wool on a homestead?
questions.fact: Hens give eggs, goats and cows give milk, and sheep give wool.

questions.q: What does the tailor knit wool into?
questions.fact: A wool beanie or a wool scarf: knitted, never bought.

questions.q: What does the homestead cat leave on the doorstep?
questions.fact: The cat comes and goes, and leaves a daisy or a sunflower.

questions.q: Where can you see every animal that ever lived on your plot?
a: The family tree on the Banana Phone
The big book at the town hall
questions.fact: The Banana Phone keeps the whole family tree.

questions.q: Which effect is NOT in Make A Banana?
questions.fact: The effects are Disco, Sparkles and Confetti.

questions.q: What does the speed slider in Make A Banana go up to?
questions.fact: It runs from chill to banana overdrive.

questions.q: Which of these is a hat in Make A Banana?
questions.fact: Also a pigeon, an arrow through the head and a fishbowl with a goldfish in it.

questions.q: Which row is NOT in Make A Banana?
questions.fact: The rows you dress a banana with are Shades, Hat, Body, Shoes and Extras.

questions.q: What can the Pixel Forge bring in with one click?
questions.fact: You can start from the original 1999 banana and make it your own.

questions.q: What name does a new Banana Pass start with?
questions.fact: Every pass starts as Fresh Dancing Banana, with an OFFICIAL stamp.

questions.q: Since when has the dancing banana been dancing?
questions.fact: Since 1999. It drew a whole world around itself after that.

questions.q: How many frames does the dancing banana GIF have?
questions.fact: Eight frames, looping forever. Make A Banana lets you pick any one of them as a pose.

questions.q: Which of these is one of the Citizens of the Week plaques?
questions.fact: The plaques are Gardener, Neighbour, Farmer and Raver, and one banana is the Citizen of the week.
